artifact_bundle.notes: Model card draft describing ranking model + features
Internal HR policy on hiring criteria and equal opportunity

normalized_intake.use_case_summary: Ranks and filters job applicants; produces candidate score + shortlist recommendation for recruiters.
normalized_intake.affected_groups: Job applicants in EU member states; includes protected classes indirectly via proxies.

model_profile.training_data_summary: Historical hiring outcomes + resume features; may include biased labels from past decisions.
model_profile.model_supply_chain: Base model (third-party) + fine-tune; feature pipeline + scoring service; unknown full provenance.

controls_current.human_oversight: Recruiters review shortlist; override exists but not tracked consistently.
controls_current.logging_traceability: Basic logs; no obligation-to-control trace or evidence graph.
controls_current.monitoring_drift: Ad-hoc; no defined KPI thresholds or bias drift monitoring.
controls_current.incident_response: General security IR only; no AI-specific incident taxonomy.
controls_current.security_controls: Standard app security; no model-specific threat model documented.
controls_current.evaluation_testing: Accuracy tests exist; fairness/robustness tests incomplete.

open_questions: Does the system place targeted job advertisements or only rank submitted applications?
Is any automated decision made without meaningful human review (e.g., auto-reject thresholds)?
What protected-attribute proxies are present (zip code, school, gaps, etc.) and what mitigation exists?
What is the exact base model/provider and versioning / change-control process?
What logs exist for overrides and adverse impact monitoring?

redaction_report.notes: Applicant identifiers removed from evaluation corpora; retained only in customer-controlled environment.
